source_findings.author_test_evidence: The PR checklist explicitly strikes out 'Wrote passing tests that cover this change', and the archived changed-file list contains only SCSS and Storybook source files.

visual_necessity_assessment.supported_claim: The four Issue screenshots add non-text layout evidence for invalid icon, AI-label, divider, close icon and chevron ordering/spacing.
visual_necessity_assessment.unsupported_claim: The screenshots do not uniquely specify the reference implementation or exact CSS constants 141px and 116px.

test_patch_assessment.reason: The PR supplied no tests. Harbor does not require a literal test.patch file, but benchmark provenance must label the current runner and manifest as curator-generated rather than author-derived. A later SWE-bench-style export may materialize an equivalent test.patch only after the test gate is approved; creating a cosmetic patch now would add no evidence.

f2p.reason: Checks that the AI decorator receives a non-none gradient; Issue 20849 explicitly requests AI gradient styling.
Divider existence is required, but ::after and exact -9px placement are one implementation rather than the only acceptable visual result.
The divider/ordering is visually relevant, but ::before and exact -9px are reference-patch choices.
Exact 141px input padding and 116px invalid-icon offset are not stated by the Issue text or uniquely derivable from the screenshots; an alternative visually correct repair can fail.

p2p.reason: Protects an existing disabled-state computed style, but not the full repository regression suite.
Protects an existing invalid helper style, but is not directly adjacent to every changed selector.
Checks combo-box-item disabled styling that the reference patch does not touch.
Checks selected item styling that the reference patch does not touch.

required_revision_before_human_test_gate: Replace exact reference CSS-value assertions with geometry or screenshot assertions derived from the expected Issue images, including explicit tolerances.
Exercise the actual combo-box component or a faithful Storybook fixture rather than only a minimal synthetic shadow-DOM fixture.
Add P2P coverage for changed selector combinations: ordinary closable, warn+closable, invalid+closable, AI-label+closable, and unaffected non-AI states.
Run a broader existing Carbon web-components regression command and record exact executed test IDs or command outcome.
Obtain independent human approval for every retained F2P/P2P meaning.
